title: The Unexpected Prom
premise: Casper Ravensworth has built his life around two careful fictions: the mild-mannered coder everyone overlooks, and 'ravensworth_ghost', the anonymous account that keeps exposing the rot beneath their elite academy's scholarship program. When his best friend Priya vanishes days before prom, leaving only her keys and a half-deleted file, Casper realizes she was investigating the same inheritance scheme he was — one that funnels endowed money to the headmaster's family. To find her, he must go public, win the coding championship that could expose the records, and survive the final basketball game where the truth will be decided. In the end, Casper chooses truth over invisibility: the account is unmasked at prom itself, Priya is found, and Casper inherits not money but a community that finally sees him.
about_author: Coral Joubert is a former boarding-school debate coach who writes stories about kids who are smarter than the adults in charge. She lives near the coast with an ancient laptop and a firm belief that prom is a plot device, not a party.

chapters.title: Everything Is Fine
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. We meet Casper mid-routine: code by day, anonymous exposés by night, best friend Priya as his only confidante. He posts about a suspicious endowment transfer and tells himself it means nothing. Emotional beat: the comfortable lie of invisibility, already cracking.

chapters.title: The Keys on the Bench
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Priya misses their study session; her keys sit on their usual bench with a note reading only 'check the ledger.' Panic sets in as her parents report her missing and the school closes ranks. Emotional beat: fear sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: What the Ledger Knows
chapters.summary: Alternating POV between Casper and Priya (in flashback). Casper decodes Priya's hidden files revealing the Ravensworth Endowment — his own family name attached — is being siphoned by Headmaster Voss. Emotional beat: the personal gut-punch of inheritance turned betrayal.

chapters.title: Tryouts for a Ghost
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. Voss announces the coding championship winner gets access to the school archives — a trap or an opening. Casper must join the team publicly, risking exposure of his anonymous account. His rival, Theo, smells something familiar in his syntax. Emotional beat: terror of being seen.

chapters.title: Theo Calls Me Ghost
chapters.summary: Theo's POV. Theo, championship favorite and secret admirer of the anonymous account, pieces together that Casper is ravensworth_ghost. Instead of exposing him, he offers an alliance — he lost someone to Voss too. Emotional beat: reluctant trust, loyalty tested before it's earned.

chapters.title: Semifinals and Smoke
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. The semifinal round goes live; Casper wins while Voss watches too closely. That night, someone ransacks his room searching for the ledger copy. A threatening note: 'Drop it or she stays gone.' Emotional beat: stakes made physical, no retreat possible.

chapters.title: The Game That Doesn't Matter
chapters.summary: Priya's POV (present tense, captive but resourceful). Priya, held at Voss's lake house, works her own escape using a smuggled phone. Her chapter reveals she discovered Casper's identity weeks ago and protected him. Emotional beat: loyalty as action, not words.

chapters.title: Final Round
chapters.summary: Casper's POV. The championship final doubles as the last basketball game of the season; the whole school watches. Casper deliberately loses the match to trigger an audit clause Priya embedded in the rules, forcing archive access. Emotional beat: sacrifice reframed as strategy.

chapters.title: Prom Night Confessions
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, climax. At prom, Casper takes the stage, unmasks himself as ravensworth_ghost, and broadcasts the ledger as Priya bursts in with evidence from the lake house. Voss is arrested mid-slow-dance. Emotional beat: the invisible boy, fully seen, choosing truth over safety.

chapters.title: Inheritance
chapters.summary: Casper's POV, epilogue weeks later. The endowment is restored and reformed; Priya, bruised but unbowed, becomes student trustee alongside Casper. He archives the ghost account — its work done — and signs his real name to a new project. Emotional beat: quiet, earned belonging; identity chosen, not hidden.
